result.summary: The home screen is generally clean and usable. The only notable visual problem is uneven restaurant-card imagery in the Fastest carousel (first card looks like a cropped plate on a pale background vs. full-bleed food photos). Category-chip and carousel overflow at the screen edge are treated as intended horizontal scrolling, not defects.

issues.description: In the Fastest near you row, Green Bowl Poké uses a small, cropped plate illustration on a large pale/grey field, while Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria Piccol use full-bleed food photos. The first card looks empty or unfinished compared with its neighbors.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent full-bleed restaurant imagery (or the same crop/aspect treatment) for every card so the carousel reads as one visual system.
